problems.problem: The previous full planar split is resolved: image 1 now shows one continuous powder-blue sweep with a diagonal shadow band, and no softboxes, lamps, stands or cameras appear. However the band renders far heavier than the declared 'narrow soft shadow band, four percent darker': measured against paper #bfd6de it sits near a saturated steel blue (roughly 25-30% darker), spans about 120-160px instead of ~60px, and its lower edge closes to a near-crisp line from behind the bottle (x≈588, y≈640) to the right edge (y≈940). At poster scale it reads as a printed stripe competing with the bottle rather than a paper undulation under broad diffused frontal light.

Contact detail crop [132,1141,668,1391] confirms the bottle IS seated: a soft grey smudge hugs the base at canvas y≈1276-1292, so offset_y 0 is correct and must not be moved, and base y=1281 (89% of canvas) keeps comfortable margins. But the smudge still spans only x≈290-500 against the 376px base footprint (bbox 212-588) and remains very low in contrast, so at poster scale the dark glass corners read slightly pasted onto the sweep. The cue needs width and a touch more presence, not repositioning.

text_product_overlap is false for logo, title and subtitle, so no collision exists; the residual weakness is internal hierarchy of the right-anchored stack. Title size did increase visibly versus the last version (bbox height 30px vs 22px, width now reaching x≈1015), but subtitle 'EAU DE PARFUM' at 22px with a 140px gap above it (title bottom y=188 to subtitle top y=298) reads as a detached fragment floating in empty paper, and the 324px rule under it cannot reconnect the two blocks; references (Prada's stacked serif mass) keep logo-title-subtitle in one continuous gravitational column.
